events.label: approval
events.text: Milan municipality approved the proposal for a third metro line.

evidence.quote: The proposal for a third metro line was approved by Milan municipality in 1977

events.text: Final project for the line was presented in early 1981.

evidence.quote: The final project was presented in early 1981 and works on the new line began on 8 September of the same year

events.text: Construction works on the new line began.

evidence.quote: Construction began in 1981 in order to be ready for the 1990 Football World Cup
